projectAiTracking.consumerScrapersMeasureTheConsumerSurfac: Consumer scrapers measure the consumer surface. Model API answers are a different source. Provider datasets are not live tracker samples. Actual model and locale may remain unknown.
projectAiTracking.budgetAndCredentialsAreCheckedAgainBefor: Budget and credentials are checked again before launch. Schedules remain disabled by default.
projectAiTracking.iApproveThisRunAndTheProviderActual: I approve this run and the provider actual cost
projectAiTracking.answerTruncatedAtTheRetentionLimit: Answer truncated at the retention limit.
projectAiTracking.searchResultsNotCitedInTheAnswerAre: Search results not cited in the answer are excluded. Brand alias matches are heuristic observations, not sentiment or ranking metrics.
projectAiTracking.aRetainedObservationWithItsSourceAndMeas: A retained observation, with its source and measurement limits.
projectAiTracking.noAIOverviewWasPresentThisIsNot: No AI Overview was present. This is not a brand mention failure.
projectAiTracking.noCompleteAnswerIsAvailableForThisSample: No complete answer is available for this sample.
projectAiTracking.noRunsYetPreviewAConfigurationToBegin: No runs yet. Preview a configuration to begin.
projectAiTracking.trackTheQuestionsThatMatterWithEvidenceY: Track the questions that matter, with evidence you can inspect.
projectAiTracking.consumerScraperModelAPIAndGoogleAIOvervi: Consumer scraper, Model API, and Google AI Overview measurements are separate sources. A saved prompt is never an automatic baseline.
projectAiTracking.schedulesUseAnExactConfigurationAndAnExp: Schedules use an exact configuration and an explicit budget approval. Disabled schedules skip execution. Missed runs are never caught up automatically.
projectAiTracking.noSchedulesConfiguredRunAManualPreviewFi: No schedules configured. Run a manual preview first.
projectAiTracking.groupPromptsAroundAQuestionYourCustomers: Group prompts around a question your customers ask.
projectAiTracking.label: Label
projectAiTracking.savingAPromptDoesNotRunItOr: Saving a prompt does not run it or spend money. Configure a source, preview the estimate, and explicitly approve a run when ready.
projectAiTracking.everyTextEditCreatesANewImmutableRevisio: Every text edit creates a new immutable revision. Existing evidence keeps the exact text it measured.
projectAiTracking.whichToolsHelpASmallTeamTrackSearch: Which tools help a small team track search visibility?
projectAiTracking.startWithAQuestionYourCustomersAsk: Start with a question your customers ask
projectAiTracking.addATopicAndAPromptNothingRuns: Add a topic and a prompt. Nothing runs until you approve a preview.

projectAiTracking.trendMethod: Project and competitor mentions are separate. Compare identical prompt revisions, source, model, locale and brand configuration, with 90% complete coverage in both periods.
projectAiTracking.contextDraftMethod: Draft neutral, comparative and branded questions from saved project context. Review each draft before accepting it. No model call or baseline starts automatically.
projectAiTracking.suggestionsUnavailable: Prompt suggestions are unavailable. Enter a prompt manually.
projectAiTracking.capabilitiesUnavailable: Model capabilities are unavailable. Review the provider connection.
projectAiTracking.modelCapabilitiesHint: Only current models with verified prices and actual-cost support are selectable. Manual identifiers are checked again before provider submission.
projectAiTracking.previewDescription: {count, number} active prompts. Preview checks configuration and cost without submitting tasks.
projectAiTracking.projectTrackingMeta: {domain} · {count, number} active prompts · schedules disabled by default
projectAiTracking.savedConfigurationReview: {count, number} saved prompts. The saved source, model, market and approval remain unchanged until you review a replacement.
projectAiTracking.replacementConfigurationScope: A replacement uses the configuration below and keeps the saved prompt selection. Preview and approve its current cost before enabling.

projectAiTracking.citationScope: Run {run}: {loaded, number} of {expected, number} expected samples loaded.
projectAiTracking.citationScopeIncomplete: Counts cover loaded evidence only. Load the remaining samples before treating these counts as a complete run.
projectAiTracking.citationScopeMethod: Each URL is counted once per citing sample. These are retained citations, not source popularity or market share.
projectAiTracking.noCitedSourcesInLoadedEvidence: No cited sources in the loaded evidence.
projectAiTracking.exportCompleted: Downloaded {count, number} samples. This export segment is complete.
projectAiTracking.exportIncomplete: Downloaded {count, number} samples. This file is incomplete: the 1,000-sample download bound was reached. Continue to download the remaining evidence.
projectAiTracking.limitedScheduleSources: Some schedule sources are outside this view
projectAiTracking.generationDescription: Review project context, competitors, market and model before approving any provider cost. Accepted drafts do not run automatically.
projectAiTracking.generationUnavailable: Model generation is unavailable. Enter a prompt manually or review the provider connection.
projectAiTracking.generationReviewMethod: These fields contain the full saved project context. Edit the reviewed scope explicitly if it exceeds the provider limit. Nothing is shortened automatically.
projectAiTracking.generationMarketMethod: Language and country are generation instructions. They do not claim dataset coverage or consumer-surface evidence.
projectAiTracking.generationScopeCount: Reviewed snapshot: {count, number} of {limit, number} characters
projectAiTracking.generationScopeTooLarge: The reviewed snapshot exceeds the provider limit. Explicitly edit the context or deselect competitors before previewing. Saved project context is unchanged.
projectAiTracking.generationReviewRequired: Review the context, model and configuration fields before previewing.
projectAiTracking.generationConsent: I approve draft generation and the provider actual cost
projectAiTracking.generationCostMethod: This forecast is advisory and has no guaranteed maximum. Credentials, pricing, budget and the exact reviewed snapshot are checked again before submission.
projectAiTracking.generationReconcileBeforeRetry: This attempt is blocked from another submission. Review its durable result or reconcile its provider receipt before starting another generation. No retry is automatic.
